# Delta Dock & Hoist LLC

> Professional dock and boat hoist installation, removal, repair, and seasonal service across South East Michigan lakes.

Delta Dock & Hoist LLC is a 5-star rated, fully insured local crew serving lake communities throughout South East Michigan, including White Lake, Whitmore Lake, Lake Orion, Pinckney, Livingston County, Fenton, Brighton, Howell, Waterford Township, Chelsea, and Milford. Phone: (734) 646-9055. Email: deltadock.hoist@gmail.com.
